Package org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.lib.join

Class StreamBackedIterator<X extends Writable>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.lib.join.StreamBackedIterator<X>
All Implemented Interfaces:
ResetableIterator<X>
Direct Known Subclasses:
StreamBackedIterator
@Public @Stable public class StreamBackedIterator<X extends Writable> extends Object implements ResetableIterator<X>
This class provides an implementation of ResetableIterator. This implementation uses a byte array to store elements added to it.

    • next

      public boolean next(X val) throws IOException
      Description copied from interface: ResetableIterator
      Assign next value to actual. It is required that elements added to a ResetableIterator be returned in the same order after a call to ResetableIterator.reset() (FIFO). Note that a call to this may fail for nested joins (i.e. more elements available, but none satisfying the constraints of the join)
      Specified by:
      next in interface ResetableIterator<X extends Writable>
      Throws:

      public void reset()
      Description copied from interface: ResetableIterator
